playstyle: Stance mix-ups with simple inputs. Get into Libertador (LIB) or Backturn (BT) and force guesses, use her i10 wall-splat punisher (1,2) to start pressure, and watch for LIB's auto-parry. Her strings mostly end in duckable highs, so do not finish them every time.

stances.name: Libertador
stances.note: Her main stance: LIB.2 is a Heat Engager, LIB.1+2 tornadoes, LIB.4,1,2 is her combo ender. Libertador auto-parries some attacks while you move in, more in Heat (Wavu).

stances.name: Backturn
stances.note: Backturned mix-ups: BT.1,2 is another i10 splat punisher and BT.1+2 launches on counter hit (Wavu).
